context: Hina oversleeps and rushes to school; Sho teases her in the genkan.
purpose: Sibling teasing morning chaos; light embarrassment.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Sharp panic on the opening. Breathless rush. High register, genuine distress without drama. The voice of someone who just realized the time.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: The alarm went off, you know.
lines.style: Soft, amused half-observation. Leans on 「で」 with a gentle tease. Warm sibling tone — not cruel, just noticing. Small knowing smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Urgent, near-frantic energy. Tight chest. Words tumbling out. Real worry underneath, but channeled into motion. No time to explain.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 急いだら、間に合うって。
lines.en: You'll make it if you hurry.
lines.style: Calm steady anchor. Quiet certainty underneath. Soft but not patronizing — he believes it. The voice of someone watching her panic and choosing not to match it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Breathless rush. Gratitude compressed into one beat. Already moving. The voice of someone grateful but too late to say more.
